name: baseline
notes: Reference: LangGraphAgent with no enhancements. Must stay enhancement-free so the reflection delta is attributable.

name: reflection
notes: LangGraphAgent + reflection enhancement. POST_APPLY_TEST fires on every failed apply+test cycle: one LLM call distils the failure into a causal post-mortem (WRONG_HYPOTHESIS / WHY_IT_FAILED / NEXT_FOCUS) that react_loop renders first in the retry prompt, ahead of the raw test_output. Breaks the pure-resample retry loop. Costs at most MAX_FIX_RETRIES extra LLM calls per run, accounted against the run budget.
